description: Create one cost centre for an entity after showing the user the exact name, kind, parent, effective date, and reason. This is one explicit centre at a time; there is no apply-all shortcut. After creating it, call list_cost_centres again and explain which mapping suggestions can now use it.

centre_kind.description: Operating or shared-support centre; defaults to operating.

effective_from.description: Date from which this centre applies; defaults to the start of the entity data.

reason.description: Why the user asked for this centre.

name: create_cost_centre
title: Create a cost centre
